title: Warmed, Humidified Carbon Dioxide Insufflation vs Standard Carbon Dioxide in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the effect of warmed, humidified carbon dioxide Insufflation vs standard carbon dioxide in laparoscopic cholecystectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of cholecystolithiasis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of cholecystolithiasis with cholecystitis
